en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-storey stone and brick institutional building with arched windows and a central entrance framed by trees and a landscaped square. The image is bordered in white with handwritten-style captions at the bottom. The reverse side has handwritten text in Hungarian, address lines, a printed instruction box about postage, and a publisher mark from Budapest.
